name: Universite du Quebec Chicoutimi
overview:
Université du Québec à Chicoutimi (UQAC)

Founded in 1969, l'Université du Québec à Chicoutimi (UQAC) is located in the heart of Saguenay - Saint-Jean Lake, a French region known for its fjord. The university has four study centers.


With 56,000 graduates, UQAC welcomes 6,500 students each year, including over 1,000 international students from more than 50 countries.

UQAC is a French-speaking university in Quebec, Canada, and welcomes more than 1,600 foreign students each year in both undergraduate and graduate programs.


It is:

  • The top university in Canada for cross-border training (by number of students)
  • The top university in Canada for research funding by project


Students appreciate:

  • Small class sizes
  • Close contact with professors
  • A campus located near the Saguenay Fjord

The campus has 22 buildings, including a sports center and a residence hall.
administrative:
1. Application dossier

You will work directly with the partner university regarding your application. All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see the Americas Teams channel for each application deadline).

If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet, please be patient.


To be given to Epitech bachelor campus administration to reenroll for the Tech4 (in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract.
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier.

This information is subject to change by the partner university. They will provide you with the most current information upon your acceptance.


2. Visa & immigration


Once you have received your admission letter, please follow these steps:

  • One semester mobility

Please read carefully UQAC's website to see what you need to prepare and make sure to have:

  • a valid passport,
  • an eTA or TRV (check if you need a visa or an eTA)


3. Health

Non-Canadian students must have a valid health and hospital insurance for the duration of their stay in Canada.


Québec has concluded social security agreements with certain countries (France, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, Greece, Luxembourg, Norway, Portugal, Romania, Sweden).

Please wait for the E-mail from the International relations office from EPITECH will all the explanation before doing the process.


You could benefit from such an agreement if you are a native of a signatory country mentioned above. You must obtain a pre-registration form from the RAMQ.


When you arrive in Saguenay, you have to follow the instructions given by UQAC.

All foreign students in Québec are required to have health and hospitalization insurance for themselves and their accompanying dependents and to maintain this insurance for the duration of their studies.


If you are admitted to university and are not covered by a reciprocity agreement on healthcare, you are automatically registered for the group health insurance plan applicable to foreign students. You will have to pay the premium in accordance with the terms and conditions determined by the university’s financial services.

You must subscribe to « Assurance Desjardins » with UQAC and it costs 81 $CA per month.


Note: we recommend to register on the register of French established outside France and to report to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs via the Ariane platform.


4. Prepare your arrival


Transport:

From your country, you will have the possibility of arriving at two international airports:

  • Montreal Pierre-Elliot Trudeau (YUL)
  • Quebec Jean Lesage (YQB)


For arriving to the campus, you can take the bus or a carpool. You can find all the information here.


Arrival at the campus:

As soon as you arrive on campus, if you have immigration documents, please go directly to 'Bureau du Registraire' (BDR) located on the first floor of the Main Lodge.


BDR Hours of Operation:

  • Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday: 9 am to 12 pm and 2 pm to 4 pm
  • Wednesday: 10 am to 12 pm and 2 pm to 4 pm

You will also need to attend the mandatory information meeting for all new international students.


Several time slots are available for your pre-entry and return.

Read carefully the international student guide:

http://www.uqac.ca/bienvenue/wp-content/uploads/2019/08/Guide-19-20.pdf

On-campus accommodation

Located on the campus and near the city center, UQAC's Val Lomberette residences provide the benefits of urban living, while offering the opportunity to enjoy a wide variety of activities in all seasons, in addition to have quick access to the university campus.


DURATION: Lease of 4 to 9 months (year-round, free July) for furnished accommodation.


RENTAL PRICES: 

  • 6 1/2 (4 bedrooms) - $ 390 per month
  • 5 1/2 (3 bedrooms) - $ 430 per month
  • 4 1/2 (2 bedrooms) - $ 435 per month
  • 3 1/2 (2 bedrooms) - $ 430 per month
  • Room-suite for 1 person - $ 430 per month
  • Studios (for single or couple) - $ 730 per month


Please book the room in the website of the residence: http://www.uquebec.ca/residencesuqac/


These apartments are fully furnished. Places are limited, it is recommended to fill the application once you have received your offer of admission.For more details, please contact http://catherine1_poulin@uqac.ca


Off-campus accommodation

​If the student residences are full and you still want to be near the campus, you could book a room in the residence 'Céged de Chicoutimi', pavillon Lemieux.


DURATION: Lease of 4 to 9 months (year-round, free July) for furnished accommodation.


RENTAL PRICE:

  • Floor 5: Small bedroom (8 x 10 ft.) - $ 385 a month
  • Floor 5: Large bedroom (16 x 10 ft.) - $ 415 per month
  • Floor 6: Studio - $ 420 per month.


ATTENTION: a deposit of $ 380 is required. Please follow the instructions by completing the form.


If you want to rent a flat in the city, you can contact once you are in Chicoutimi the Student Services team for free home search assistance. Please note this is a service you will enjoy once you arrive on campus (and not at a distance). You will need to book a temporary accommodation for the period you are looking for your housing. courses:
Credits and Courses

To obtain you 60 ECTS, you will have to validate 12 local credits during your semester abroad.

  • 1st semester (September - December): full-time 4-month internship (20 ECTS) + take part in additional online activities (10 ECTS). Please start your internship research as soon as possible.
  • 2nd semester (January - end of April): you will have to take 12 local credits in order to validate the 30 ECTS remaining.


You can take 4 courses per semester, as most of the courses are for 3 credits.


Academic Calendar

Classes begin from beginning of January to end of April (semester 2 / Winter semester).


Please check the academic calendar (autumn & winter) here.


Program and Language

You will attend the short graduate program in computer science with local & international students:

https://programmes.uqac.ca/0711/officiel


Classes are taught in French and are theoretical.
cost:
Pour les étudiants en échange sans diplomation, bien que les droits de scolarité soient généralement couverts par l’université d’attache, des frais institutionnels obligatoires (FIO) sont à régler. Les FIO sont chargés trimestriellement à tous les étudiants et doivent être réglés à la date limite du 1er versement des droits de scolarité de chaque trimestre.


Pour connaître la date limite, référez-vous aux calendriers universitaires :

Voici le détail des frais obligatoires pour les étudiants à temps plein :

(Ces montants sont basés sur un trimestre précédent et peuvent donc être modifiés sans avis préalable)

  • Frais généraux : 58,49 $
  • Accès libre STS (Vous donne accès au transport en commun de la ville de Saguenay) : 41,00 $
  • Cotisation MAGE (l’association étudiante de tous les étudiants de l’UQAC) : 26,25 $
  • Services aux étudiants et sports (SAE) : 7,22 $ par crédit inscrit
  • Droits d'auteur : 0,36 $ par crédit inscrit
  • Frais technologique : 6,14 $ par crédit inscrit
  • Association étudiante : 9 $ à 20 $ (selon le programme d’études et le département auquel il se rattache)


D’autres frais seront aussi ajoutés à la facture, mais peuvent être retirés à la demande de l’étudiant, sous certaines conditions.

  • Campagne de financement : 15,00 $ (écrire à srf@uqac.ca pour faire retirer ce montant)
  • Assurance étudiants internationaux : 324,00 $ (Peut être retirée sous présentation d’une preuve de couverture par la RAMQ qui est offerte aux étudiants provenant de pays qui ont signé une entente de sécurité sociale avec le Québec. Notez qu’il est obligatoire pour tous les étudiants d’être couvert par la RAMQ ou cette assurance.)
  • Assurance ASEQ : 110,00 $ (Assurances additionnelles offerte par le MAGE-UQAC en collaboration avec l’ASEQ, mais non obligatoire. Consulter le site de l’ASEQ pour connaître les modalités du retrait de cette assurance)


Notez que les prix pour l’accès libre au transport en commun, l’Assurance Desjardins ainsi que l’assurance ASEQ reflète les tarifs actuels, mais sont sujets à révision en prévision de la session d’automne 2024.


Pour plus d’informations sur les assurances incluant la procédure de couverture pour la RAMQ, et les détails de couverture pour l’assurance Desjardins et ASEQ, consultez ce lien.
